invariants.rationale: The method expects 'layer' to be a valid TiledMapImageLayer instance as it is used immediately.
The code safely handles the case where layer.getTextureRegion() returns null, otherwise expects it to be a TextureRegion.
Parallax factors are typically non-negative for image layers; negative parallax would lead to reversed scrolling, which is unusual.
Similarly, parallaxY is expected to be non-negative in most use cases.
Image layers are generally rendered only if visible; this is a typical expectation for rendering routines.
